sections.heading: Fireflies.ai limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Free storage (400 min/team) burns down fast; transcription unlimited is not unlimited retention; Conversation intelligence and team analytics unlock on Business; SSO, HIPAA, and private storage are Enterprise-only because it forces process changes or add-ons around Fireflies.ai when LLM chat and assistants is the job.

Pricing interpretation: stay on Free until enterprise admin and SSO (Free, Pro, Business, Enterprise) is mandatory; plan jumps to Pro only after that hinge is proven.

Plan trade-off: you gain enterprise admin and SSO (Free, Pro, Business, Enterprise) at the expense of Published free tiers vs paid usage/credit caps — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Free · free · LLM chat and assistants | Pro | Business.

Alternative context: unlike Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai is preferable when Teams that want auto-join transcripts across Zoom/Meet/Teams because LLM chat and assistants plus enterprise admin and SSO (Free, Pro, Business, Enterprise) match; prefer Otter.ai when Buyers who need a general LLM (ChatGPT) because the operating loops differ.
